TreePPL compiler options

Source: R/model.R
tp_treeppl_options.Rd

tp_treeppl_options() reads the inference methods and options supported by the TreePPL compiler (tpplc --help) and displays them in the console. Inference methods are passed to the method argument of tp_sampler(), compile options to the ... of tp_sampler(), and runtime options to the ... of tp_run().

Usage

tp_treeppl_options(what = c("all", "methods", "compile", "runtime"))

Arguments

what

Which information to show: "all" (inference methods, compile options and runtime options), "methods", "compile" or "runtime".

Value

A data frame with columns type ("methods", "compile" or "runtime"), argument, value and description (invisibly). For methods, argument is the method name (e.g., "mcmc") and value is NA; for options, argument is the argument name (e.g., "subsample_size") and value the type of value expected: "integer", "number", "string" or "logical" (flags without a value).

Details

Options are shown in the form accepted by tp_sampler() and tp_run(), with the type of value they expect. The type is translated from the placeholder used in tpplc --help:

  • INT or N: <integer>, e.g. --subsample-size INT is shown as subsample_size = <integer>;

  • FLOAT: <number>;

  • any other placeholder (ARG, FILE, <option>, ...): <string>;

  • no placeholder (a flag without a value): <logical>, e.g. subsample = <logical>. Use TRUE to set the flag.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tp_treeppl_options("runtime")

# the returned data frame can be searched
opts <- tp_treeppl_options("compile")
opts[grepl("resample", opts$argument), ]
} # }
